slots.node01.rows.item01.a: Structure interviews and surface knowledge gaps without asking experts to write every artifact.

slots.node01.rows.item03.h: Technology leaders confirm trade-offs and boundaries.
slots.node01.rows.item04.a: Create process alternatives and working prototypes, then test them with users.
slots.node01.rows.item04.h: People decide what should change and what will work.
slots.node01.rows.item05.a: Preserve operating knowledge, prepare people for new roles and retain context.
slots.node01.rows.item05.h: Leaders own adoption, readiness and accountability.
